columns.name: model_year
columns.description: The model year of the truck.

columns.name: headquarter
columns.description: Set to 'Texas (TX)' if the make is 'Peterbilt', set to 'North Carolina (NC)' if the make is Mack, set to 'Washington (WA)' if the make is 'Kenworth'

columns.name: num_shipments
columns.description: The number of shipment delivered by the truck model, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: person_receive_heaviest_shipment
columns.description: The person who received the heaviest shipment delivered by the truck model, with ties broken by the ascending order of the customer name

columns.name: per_weight_exceed_10000
columns.description: The percentage of shipments that exceed 10,000 pounds among all shipments delivered by the truck model.

columns.name: num_shipments_change_from_2016_to_2017
columns.description: The number of shipments change from 2016 to 2017 delivered by the truck model, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: first_name
columns.description: The first name of the driver.

columns.name: last_name
columns.description: The last name of the driver.

columns.name: num_shipments_2017
columns.description: The number of shipments the driver delivered in 2017, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_shipment_to_least_populated_city
columns.description: The number of shipments to the least populated city delivered by the driver, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_shipment_placed_by_Autoware_Inc
columns.description: The percentage of shipments placed by Autoware Inc among all shipments delivered by the driver.

columns.name: has_a_shipment_weight_greater_95_per_avg_across_all_shipments
columns.description: Set to 1 if the driver has a shipment with a weight greater than 95% of the average weight of all shipments, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: weight_first_shipment
columns.description: The weight the driver transported during his/her first shipment, with ties broken by the descending order of the weight.
